Class MethodValidationPostProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.framework.ProxyConfig
org.springframework.aop.framework.ProxyProcessorSupport
org.springframework.aop.framework.AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor
org.springframework.aop.framework.autoproxy.AbstractBeanFactoryAwareAdvisingPostProcessor
org.springframework.validation.beanvalidation.MethodValidationPostProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AopInfrastructureBean, Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, BeanFactoryAware, BeanPostProcessor, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor, SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor, InitializingBean, Ordered
public class MethodValidationPostProcessor extends AbstractBeanFactoryAwareAdvisingPostProcessor implements InitializingBean
A convenient BeanPostProcessor implementation that delegates to a JSR-303 provider for performing method-level validation on annotated methods.

适用的方法在其参数和/或返回值（在后一种情况下指定在方法级别，通常作为内联注解）上具有 JSR-303 约束注解，例如：

public @NotNull Object myValidMethod(@NotNull String arg1, @Max(10) int arg2)

在出现验证错误时，拦截器可以抛出ConstraintViolationException，或者将违规项适配为MethodValidationResult并抛出MethodValidationException。

带有此类注释的方法的目标类需要在类型级别上标注 Spring 的Validated 注解，以便搜索其方法中的内联约束注解。验证组也可以通过@Validated指定。默认情况下，JSR-303 仅针对其默认组进行验证。

Since:
3.1
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • setValidatedAnnotationType

      public void setValidatedAnnotationType(Class<? extends Annotation> validatedAnnotationType)
      Set the 'validated' annotation type. The default validated annotation type is the Validated annotation.

      此 Setter 属性存在，以便开发人员提供自己的（非 Spring 特定）注解类型，以指示该类应进行验证，即应用方法验证。

      Parameters:
      validatedAnnotationType - 期望的注解类型

    • setValidatorFactory

      默认值是默认 ValidatorFactory 的默认 Validator。

    • setAdaptConstraintViolations

      public void setAdaptConstraintViolations(boolean adaptViolations)
      Whether to adapt ConstraintViolations to MethodValidationResult.

      默认情况下为false，在这种情况下，如果发生违规将抛出ConstraintViolationException。当设置为true时，将抛出MethodValidationException，并附带方法验证结果。

      Since:
      6.1

    • afterPropertiesSet

      public void afterPropertiesSet()
      描述从接口复制：InitializingBean
      Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.

      此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

      Specified by:
      `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`
